verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is a Privacy Center setting to stop Anthropic using new chats and coding sessions for model training. That is a data-use-for-training control, a related but different switch from opting out of telemetry or usage tracking. Nothing in the pack documents a way to disable telemetry, analytics or usage tracking for the API, apps or SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
